baseline.existing_runtime: ACE daemon already runs TaskPool and MinerPool, but the new closed-loop engine was not connected to a model-backed planning stage

change.behavior: Observed self-evolution proposals are sent to up to three diverse MinerPool models for candidate decomposition and metric planning; valid candidates enter TaskPool for the existing Researcher/Validator/Guardian path

test.regression: py -3 -m pytest -q ops/test_closed_loop_engine.py ops/test_closed_loop_background.py ops/test_self_evolution.py ops/test_24h_runtime_mainline.py -x

evaluation.new_capability: model-backed bounded planning with idempotent TaskPool admission
evaluation.promotion_boundary: model output never directly changes production or capability state

painful_review.cost: 每个新观察候选最多调用 3 个模型，并增加一次 TaskPool 计划审议
painful_review.counterfactual: 若不接桥，闭环引擎只能被手工调用，矿池模型不会参与自我拆解
painful_review.recurrence_risk: 中；任何绕过 TaskPool 的新后台入口都可能重新形成旁路
painful_review.reusable_lesson: 模型只能规划，证据、指标和晋升仍由 ACE 本地门禁收口

next_action: 等待真实 Observed proposal 触发一次后台计划，检查 plans.jsonl、TaskPool 任务和模型路由收据
